outcome: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section, instrumental delivery, unassisted vaginal birth)
cohort: Live-born, singleton, cephalic, non-anomalous pregnancies undergoing IOL between 37 + 0 and 42 + 0 weeks in Australia
finding: After controlling for confounders, advanced maternal age was independently associated with a two-fold increase in birth by Cesarean section following induction of labor.
